Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops

Class IonicAqueousPhaseEquilibrium

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.IonicAqueousPhaseEquilibrium
final class IonicAqueousPhaseEquilibrium extends Object
Dual-cubic-root phase search for non-reactive water-rich ionic feeds.

The search starts from a conserved aqueous reference and independently seeds every positive molecular solute on both GAS and OIL roots. Ions remain confined to the aqueous phase. A result is accepted only after the shared solver qualifies tangent-plane instability, component inventory, molecular fugacity equality, normalization, and Gibbs energy. This is a numerical phase-selection operation and does not alter thermodynamic parameters or model equations.
